description: Create contacts between specified zone joints. The ranges apply to zone faces on either side of the joints. If no ranges are specified then contacts between all facets are created. This operation is only necessary if contacts have not been created with the zone joint create command.
notes: Documented in the 'wad' (wall-and-discontinuity) doc tree, not under flac3d/ -- which is why this family is absent from the FLAC zone corpus.
Parsed from the installed 9.7 wad doc tree; command presence confirmed on live MPoint3D 9.7 (same 9.0 zone kernel). Not probed on a FLAC3D binary.
The engine accepts both 'create-contact' (the documented spelling) and 'create-contacts'; 'zone joint ?' enumerates only the plural. Aliases. (syntax)

keywords.name: range-1
keywords.description: Specify the range used to select zone faces on one side of the joint.

keywords.name: range-2
keywords.description: Specify the range used to select zone faces on the other side of the joint.

keywords.name: tolerance
keywords.description: Specify the relative contact detection tolerance. By default the relative contact detection tolerance is 1e-8.

keywords.name: tolerance-angle
keywords.description: Specify the angular tolerance, in degrees, between zone face normals for contacts to be created. By default the angular tolerance is 2 degrees. This is a global value.
